svg.text: netops-lab: from the repository to the network, the cluster and the agent
Dual-DC Arista EVPN-VXLAN multi-site fabric · k3s Kubernetes across both DCs · infrastructure as code · GitOps · telemetry to Elastic
③ Lab host 192.168.20.56 · containerlab (one Linux host, every box a container)
OSPF area 0 underlay · iBGP EVPN overlay · VTEPs 10.1.1.x
OSPF area 0 underlay · iBGP EVPN overlay · VTEPs 10.2.1.x
underlay eBGP (BGW loopbacks) + VRF PROD on .100 sub-interfaces (VRF-lite)
web app VIPs: 192.0.2.10 public (to the WAN) · 10.99.0.10 internal · announced only by nodes with a ready pod
the agent's fix is a pull request: CI plans it, an engineer approves, the merge deploys it
